CodBi_People_Alphanumeric.description: Apply to an XTextField that should only accept alphanumeric characters (letters and numbers, no special chars). Useful for IDs, usernames, alphanumeric codes.

CodBi_People_Name.description: Apply to any XTextField or XTextArea that represents a person's name (e.g. Vorname, Nachname, full name). When you create such a field, you MUST also ensure the 'People' standard configuration is checked/active in the form properties (codbi-prop-standards).

CodBi_People_BuildingNumber.description: Apply to an XTextField that represents a building/house number in an address. Accepts digits, letters and slashes.

CodBi_People_Mail.description: Apply to an XTextField that represents an email address. Validates email format.

CodBi_People_18plus.description: Apply to an XTextField with datatype='dateDE' for date-of-birth fields. Enforces minimum age of 18 years.

CodBi_People_16plus.description: Apply to an XTextField with datatype='dateDE' for date fields. Enforces minimum age of 16 years.

CodBi_People_Phone.description: Apply to an XTextField that represents a phone number. Formats input using Cleave with German phone format.

CodBi_People_PLZ.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a German postal code (PLZ). Formats input using Cleave with 5-digit numeral format.

CodBi_Fotocropper.description: Apply to the container element of a photo cropper setup. Use together with Fotocropper_Board, Fotocropper_Uploader, Fotocropper_Update, Fotocropper_ImageURL and Fotocropper_Foto.

CodBi_Fotocropper_Board.description: Apply to the container element that holds the cropper preview board.
CodBi_Fotocropper_Board.descriptionDe: Auf das Container-Element anwenden, das die Zuschneide-Vorschaufläche enthält.
CodBi_Fotocropper_Board.descriptionIt: Applicare all'elemento contenitore che ospita l'area di anteprima del ritaglio.

CodBi_Fotocropper_Uploader.description: Apply to the file upload (XUpload) element for the photo cropper.
CodBi_Fotocropper_Uploader.descriptionDe: Auf das Datei-Upload-Element (XUpload) des Foto-Zuschneiders anwenden.
CodBi_Fotocropper_Uploader.descriptionIt: Applicare all'elemento di caricamento file (XUpload) del ritaglio foto.

CodBi_Fotocropper_Update.description: Apply to the update button element for the photo cropper.
CodBi_Fotocropper_Update.descriptionDe: Auf die Aktualisieren-Schaltfläche des Foto-Zuschneiders anwenden.
CodBi_Fotocropper_Update.descriptionIt: Applicare al pulsante di aggiornamento del ritaglio foto.

CodBi_Fotocropper_ImageURL.description: Apply to a hidden field that receives the cropped image URL.
CodBi_Fotocropper_ImageURL.descriptionDe: Auf ein verstecktes Feld anwenden, das die URL des zugeschnittenen Bildes erhält.
CodBi_Fotocropper_ImageURL.descriptionIt: Applicare a un campo nascosto che riceve l'URL dell'immagine ritagliata.

CodBi_Fotocropper_Foto.description: Apply to the target image element that shows the cropped photo.
CodBi_Fotocropper_Foto.descriptionDe: Auf das Zielbild-Element anwenden, das das zugeschnittene Foto anzeigt.
CodBi_Fotocropper_Foto.descriptionIt: Applicare all'elemento immagine di destinazione che mostra la foto ritagliata.

CodBi_People_OpenPLZ_AC_SET_PLZ.description: Apply to the postal code input in an OpenPLZ address autocomplete set within a People context.

CodBi_People_OpenPLZ_AC_SET_Locality.description: Apply to the locality/city input in an OpenPLZ address autocomplete set within a People context.

CodBi_People_OpenPLZ_AC_SET_Street.description: Apply to the street input in an OpenPLZ address autocomplete set within a People context.

CodBi_People_OpenPLZ_AC_SET_BuildingNumb.description: Apply to the building number input in an OpenPLZ address autocomplete set within a People context.

CodBi_OpenPLZ_Select_Localities.description: Apply to an XSelect that should be filled with localities/cities from OpenPLZ based on the country code in CodBi_OpenPLZ_Country.

CodBi_OpenPLZ_Select_Streets_By_PLZ.description: Apply to an XSelect that should be filled with streets from OpenPLZ based on the entered postal code.

CodBi_OpenPLZ_Select_Orga_Bundeslaender.description: Apply to an XSelect that should be filled with German federal states (Bundesländer).

CodBi_OpenPLZ_Select_Orga_Bayern.description: Apply to an XSelect that should be filled with Bavarian government regions (Regierungsbezirke).
